description: NaTbTi₂O₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.69 Å. Tb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Tb-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.67 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-36°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.10 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Tb, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, one Tb, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Tb, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tb, and two equivalent Ti atoms.
